<div class="card-body">
'''Full Throttle''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">フル・スロットル</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロット（または専属パイロット）が、単独で星系を防御している場合、戦闘運命数を1枚引いて足す。防御しているのがルークならば、戦闘運命数を1枚引いた上に、戦闘力を＋１できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-81o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">反乱軍パイロットは、肉眼で状況を判断してセンサーの不備を補う。数で勝る帝国軍に対抗するには、自分の五感こそが頼みの綱なのだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Full Throttle.

'''Card text:''' If a pilot (or permanent pilot) is defending a system alone, add one battle destiny. If that defender is Luke, add one battle destiny and power +1.

'''Lore:''' Rebel pilots use the naked eye to make up for incomplete sensors. Against Imperial numbers, their own senses are what they rely on.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese adds power +1 when the lone defender is Luke; the English presents the Luke bonus as a separate OR.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Full Throttle]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
